title: Who played in Jack Lane's and Pansy Lane's bands
summary: He cannot recall Jack Lane's men, being 16, but names Foots Mello, Harry Shields and Pansy in Pansy Lane's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Uh, who was in Jack Lane's band when you started?
Jack Lane's band? My God, I don't remember. I don't remember, to tell you the truth. I couldn't remember one man that was in that band.
I guess you were quite young at the time.
Oh yeah, I was only a kid. I was merely a kid at that time.
Do you remember who any of the fellas with the Pansy Lane's band were?
I remember that, uh, Leon Mello's brother played drum.
We used to call him Foots. Bigfoot. We used to call him Foots Mello. And Harry Shields played clarinet. Pansy played trumpet. And, uh, who played piano now? I don't remember who played piano with us.
They had pianos back in those days.
